name: external_dependency_failure
description: Alerts on recurring database or vector database errors

query_condition.sql: SELECT count(*) as total, dependency, min(trace_id) as trace_ref FROM "default" WHERE service_name IN ('scribe-backend', 'scribe_backend') AND event_type IN ('database_error', 'qdrant_error', 'health_check_failure') GROUP BY dependency HAVING count(*) > 10
